_notes.activitiesDir: The folder of GPX files, relative to this file, for example "activities". Leave it empty to show the sample year that ships with the app.
_notes.units: "km" or "mi": distances, paces, and splits use it.
_notes.sports: Which activities to show: any of "run", "ride", "walk", and "hike". An empty list shows them all.
_notes.year: The year the wall opens on, such as 2026. The year filter lists every year found; null opens on the latest.
_notes.theme: "asphalt" (near-black tiles, white routes), "trail" (bone-white tiles, ink routes), or "auto" (trail by day, asphalt by night, following the device).
